bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/app.rs, springboard/sdk/src/document.rs, springboard/sdk/src/observable.rs, springboard/sdk/src/defaults.rs, springboard/sdk/src/restoration.rs, springboard/ui/src/nav.rs
summary: Apps are written in an imperative Rust App trait with retained views, not a declarative View/Scene/App protocol tree. Most App-structure and Data-and-storage topics have a feature-level counterpart (documents, sheets, toolbars, search field, observable values, defaults, state restoration); SwiftData-style model persistence, app extensions in the SwiftUI sense have none, and the Environment and preference keys exist only as models.

features.apple: Adopting Liquid Glass, SwiftUI updates, Landmarks sample
features.note: Glass material exists in the renderer; no adoption guide or sample app for the SwiftUI API since there is no SwiftUI API

features.apple: App protocol, @main entry point, app lifecycle
features.note: App trait with hooks and a manifest; imperative, not a declarative App body Refreshed 2026-10-17: value-based NavigationPath destinations exist in springboard/ui/src/nav.rs (NavigationPath<D>, apply_path; tests nav::tests).

The active, inactive and background phases and the once-per-change tracker are tested headless. Gap: the shell does not yet send window visibility and focus to apps, and there is one window per app with no multi-scene composition.

features.apple: Window, WindowGroup, openWindow, window styles and sizing
features.note: Several windows of one app work: SceneSessions opens (request), focuses, lists and closes each window with its own state, user info and a limit, and the shell serves those calls (sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-31.rs). Gap: a restored window's frame after a relaunch is checked only on Midget. Refreshed 2026-10-17: openWindow is SceneSessions.request in springboard/sdk/src/scene_session.rs, so one app can open, focus and close several windows.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. NSDocument-style API with file grants; no declarative DocumentGroup or versioned-document UI
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 29 tests. Push/pop stack, split view, sidebar models; no value-based destinations or NavigationPath
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. Sheets and alerts exist; popover and confirmation dialog not confirmed as separate APIs

Groups, overflow, validation and menu anchors are tested headless (headless_toolbar_* in ui/tests). Hiding, showing, moving and resetting items, with required items kept, are tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-26.rs. Gap: no customization sheet draws the choice, and the toolbar does not yet save the order between launches.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/search.rs; springboard/ui/src/search_scope.rs (SearchBar); tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01b.rs; springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-26.rs; springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs; wired: springboard/apps/news-desktop/src/news.rs (BAR_SEARCH, key, search_focused), springboard/apps/news-desktop/src/wire.rs (search_rows), springboard/ui/src/textfind.rs, springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (search_field)
features.note: Field geometry, the clear button and its hit area are tested headless (headless_search_field_* in ui/tests). The scope choice, the tokens and the prefix suggestions are tested headless in parity_sdk-complete-26.rs. Gap: the scopes, tokens and suggestions are not yet drawn by the search_field widget. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 6 (0.5.44); verify on Midget for parity.

A scene registry lists what a host may present, keeps the user's approval per app and scene, and round-trips that choice through prefs lines, tested in the host unit tests of ui/src/extensions.rs. Gap: the only consumer is the file sync model, the shell draws no approval list yet and no app declares a scene, so no desktop widget is shown; Midget is needed to check the list.
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 23 tests. Observable values with subscribers; no automatic view invalidation from dependency tracking

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 28 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Appearance and locale are readable globals; no view-hierarchy environment propagation

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 28 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No child-to-parent preference channel; layout is computed by the app

UserDefaults and state restoration cover AppStorage and SceneStorage, and Codable values include Data (headless tests in parity_sdk-complete-19.rs); no SwiftData/Core Data object graph store is wired to apps.

gaps: No view tree reads environment values or preference keys. The models exist: springboard/ui/src/environment.rs (Environment, scoped, with_value; tests) and springboard/ui/src/preferences.rs (PreferenceKey, Preferences; tests), but no view binds them.
No SwiftData/Core Data style model store
No desktop widgets or app extension points
